# LLMWhisperer

LLMWhisperer is a technology that presents data from complex documents to LLMs in a way that they can best understand.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/llmwhisperer/.

## Actions

- **Check Whisper Status** (read-only): Check the status of a text extraction process in LLMWhisperer.
- **Convert Document to Text**: Convert PDFs and scanned documents into LLM-optimized text format asynchronously.
- **Get Usage Information** (read-only): Check usage metrics of your LLMWhisperer account.
- **Register Webhook**: Register a new webhook endpoint for LLMWhisperer async notifications.
- **Retrieve Whisper Text** (read-only): Retrieve extracted text from asynchronous whisper processing.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a registered webhook from LLMWhisperer system.
- **Get Usage Statistics** (read-only): Retrieve usage statistics for your LLMWhisperer account based on a specific tag.
- **Get Webhook Details** (read-only): Retrieve registered webhook details for LLMWhisperer.
- **Get Whisper Detail** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive details about ongoing or completed text extraction process.
- **Update Webhook Configuration**: Update an existing webhook configuration for document conversion callbacks.
